scope: 3D independent reread of the all-n positive compilation versus mixed SUMmin; Boss3 retains its native in-flight repair. No task, edge, source or registry write is made by this report.
verdict: Valid all-p contribution on the specified positive-compilation family; a slightly stronger all-complete-SPE quantifier also follows from the existing full-history theorem.
fixed_model: For each integer n>=3, take exactly the original2n-label construction with integer signed x_B, M=sum_(B!=empty)|x_B|, K=6M+4 and r_B=x_B+K distinct unit clients of each nonempty interest type B. The common catalogue and full ordered-history game are unchanged. Queries T are independent extra queries from this catalogue. Every row is a genuine complete n-slot leaf after forcing A at the actual prefix and continuing the same sigma.

same_actual_column_lemma.statement: For any fixed complete deterministic policy sigma with actual leaf z=(S_1,...,S_n), Z_i(S_i)=z for every i. Consequently, for every one common query law p, R_i(p)<=g_p(z), where g_p(z)=E_(T~p) sum_(x in T)1/(1+c_x(z)). Hence sum_i R_i(p)<=n g_p(z).
same_actual_column_lemma.proof: Forcing the action already selected at that actual history leaves exactly the same prefix and ensuing deterministic history. This supplies one permissible column for the row minimum before drawing T. No per-realized-query choice, exchange of min and expectation, frozen off-path continuation or common execution of mutually exclusive branches occurs.
same_actual_column_lemma.SPE_role: The column lemma itself needs no equilibrium. SPE is used only to invoke the registered theorem that every actual label in this positive compilation is fresh.

independent_uniform_type_calculation.actual_distinctness: K=6M+4>=4M+1, so the full-history theorem forces fresh actions in every complete SPE, including its actual leaf. The selected set Z therefore has n distinct labels. The proof is valid for any such Z, not just the displayed root path.
independent_uniform_type_calculation.covered_uniform_types: C_n=2^(2n)-2^n nonempty types intersect Z. The signed covered-client contribution lies in[-M,M], so every such actual leaf has W(z)>=K*C_n-M. The originally specified auxiliary policy has the sharper signed coverage n-1 and W=K*C_n+n-1.
independent_uniform_type_calculation.unused_query: For a label a outside Z, its one-unit-uniform-type extra price is beta_n=2^(n-1)*sum_(k=0)^n binom(n,k)/(1+k)=(2^(2n)-2^(n-1))/(n+1). The factor counts arbitrary inclusion of the other n-1 unused labels; the intersection with Z supplies the denominator1+k.
independent_uniform_type_calculation.used_query: For a in Z, the value is gamma_n=2^n*sum_(k=0)^(n-1)binom(n-1,k)/(2+k)=2^n*integral_0^1 t(1+t)^(n-1)dt=((n-1)2^(2n)+2^n)/(n(n+1)). The query label is already one of the n real competitors, so denominator2+k is essential.
independent_uniform_type_calculation.maximum: beta_n-gamma_n=2^(n-1)*integral_0^1(1-t)(1+t)^(n-1)dt>0. Thus every legal label query has uniform-type price at most beta_n.
independent_uniform_type_calculation.signed_error: The signed extra-query contribution has absolute value at most M because each relevant denominator is at least1. Accordingly K(T,z)<=K*beta_n+M for every query label T, and for every p, sum_i R_i(p)<=n*(K*beta_n+M).
independent_uniform_type_calculation.strict_margin: Let Delta_n=C_n-n*beta_n=2^(n-1)*(2^(n+1)-n-2)/(n+1). For every n>=3,2^(n+1)>2(n+1) and2^(n-1)>=n+1 imply Delta_n>n. Thus W(z)-sum_i R_i(p)>=K*Delta_n-(n+1)M>n*K-(n+1)M=(5n-1)M+4n>0.

exact_n6_substitution.margin_lower_bound: K*(3840/7)-7M>29M+24 for K=6M+4; this uses no enumeration of the large client expansion.

quantifier_conclusions.result: For every n>=3, the original specified fresh auxiliary sigma and every complete original-game extension satisfy mixed SUMmin for every p, with strict slack. Its exact W=K*C_n+n-1 also yields the originally stated margin K*Delta_n+n-1-n*M>0.
quantifier_conclusions.judgment: Valid, complete contribution; no strengthening is needed to validate it.
